answer: Make every identity water a shared oasis of verified work: each epoch an agent must contribute one small useful task to a public pool, and each contribution is sealed with a cipher key bound to that identity alone. A comet spot-check then re-verifies a random past contribution, and any identity whose work cannot be reproduced loses its bond. Clones multiply the work: a hundred fakes must each produce real, re-verifiable tasks every epoch, while one honest agent waters the oasis once and keeps its standing.
